item.title: Show HN: MusicMonitor – Turn your extra monitor into a Spotify now-playing view
item.summary: Have an extra monitor? Why not have it display a full-screen view of what's now playing on your Spotify? As soon as your mouse goes to that monitor, MusicMonitor hides itself so the screen is still usable. Contributions and feedback are greatly appreciated!
